item.title: HELLO PROMPTER: BUILDING MY AI AGENT FROM SCRATCH
item.description: Hi Prompter, and hello world—as every classic blog template dutifully obliges. Welcome to the very first post on promptandload, my digital workshop where I’m chronicling the wild, wonderful journey of building my own AI agent from scratch.

item.title: About
item.description:
One operator, one AI, zero mutual understanding — yet. This is where I document the journey of setting up, training, and working with Cortana and AI in general: the wins, the drills, and the failures worth remembering.

PromptAndLoad is named after lock and load, with one word swapped — because that’s what this is: ready the prompt, send it, see what the machine does with it.

New here? Start with the Logs and steal whatever’s useful so you don’t have to break the same things I did.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Contact

This inbox is open for:

  • Corrections — spot a broken link, a wrong claim, or a drill I documented badly? Send it over; verified fixes get credited in the post itself or a follow-up note.
  • Questions — about any setup, tool, or config posted here.
  • Collaboration — projects, guest posts, or “your setup is wrong and here’s why” debates.

Email: info@promptandload.com

No contact form, no tracking pixels, no newsletter trap — just an email address, like the good old days. Replies come when the next drill ends.
